title: Six-block multinomial ratio limit
statement: For every natural number $d$, as $m\to\infty$ the ratio of the multinomial coefficient with six parts of size $d$ and a seventh part of size $m$ to $\binom{m+6d}{3d}^2$ converges to $\frac{((3d)!)^2}{(d!)^6}$.
